finding_note.title: Vault external invalid signed request consumes nonce without burning Message Budget
finding_note.decision: This is intentional v1 anti-replay policy, not a forgotten value-flow bug. Invalid signatures and pre-accept structural/session failures reject without nonce or budget mutation. Validly signed malformed profile/max_charge requests are accepted only far enough to consume nonce and then return without Message Budget debit, CapsuleHub publish, or PLATO fee.

production_note: Clients should treat any signed external session request as nonce-consuming once submitted if the signature is valid, even when the request is malformed or stale. Re-sign with the next nonce after any validly signed external submission.
